items.name: The weekly schedule shows each dressing room's own sauna days
items.rule: Availability is per dressing room, per weekday
items.evidence: GET /api/schedule: ph8 Tuesday 17:00 and 18:30 free; ph9 only Thursday, Friday and Saturday, no Tuesday slots.

items.name: A standing slot cannot be requested on a closed day
items.rule: Availability is per dressing room, per weekday
items.evidence: POST /api/bookings ph9 Tuesday 17:00 returned 409 closed-day: "pukuhuone 9 has no sauna day on Tuesday. It opens Thursday, Friday, Saturday. You can request pukuhuone 8 (ph8) on Tuesday at 17:00. This alternative is open and free. Its standing-slot request fields are {"resource":"ph8","weekday":"Tuesday","start":"17:00"}."

items.name: A requested slot on an open day is confirmed
items.rule: A slot is confirmed against availability and held by one household
items.evidence: POST standing request returned 201; GET bookings re-read apartment 12 Tuesday 17:00–18:30 weekly holding.

items.name: A held slot cannot be confirmed for another household
items.rule: A slot is confirmed against availability and held by one household
items.evidence: Apartment 3 POST same slot returned 409; GET bookings retains apartment 12 holding.

items.name: A second standing slot is granted while there is room
items.rule: A household may hold a second standing slot when there is room
items.evidence: POST apartment 12 ph8 Tuesday 18:30: 201 booking-3 confirmed; GET bookings and schedule persist both booking-1 and booking-3 for 12.

items.name: A second standing slot is refused when the schedule is full
items.rule: A household may hold a second standing slot when there is room
items.evidence: POST apartment 12 ph8 Tuesday 18:30: 409 full: The weekly schedule has no free standing slot. No alternative offered; GET bookings and schedule retain exactly one for 12.

items.name: Confirming a booking updates all three derived views together
items.rule: One booking is the single source of truth for the list, the timer and the billing
items.evidence: POST /api/bookings returned 201 booking-1 for household 12, Tuesday 17:00–18:30 in ph8. GET /api/views showed booking-1 in posted, heater (heat=true, 17:00–18:30), and billing (payer 12).

items.name: Giving up a slot leaves no derived view still claiming it
items.rule: One booking is the single source of truth for the list, the timer and the billing
items.evidence: POST /api/bookings returned 201 booking-1 for 12; GET /api/views showed it in posted, heater, and billing. POST /api/bookings/booking-1/give-up returned 200; GET /api/views showed none of those signals for booking-1.

items.name: Two households request the same free slot with neither request answered
items.rule: Two households requesting one free slot leave exactly one holder
items.evidence: GET schedule showed ph8 Tuesday 17:00 free. Issued both POST /api/bookings without awaiting either response: apartment 12 received 201, apartment 3 received 409 held. GET bookings showed only 12; GET views showed one posted entry, one heater entry, and one billing payer, all booking-1.

items.name: The race is run one hundred times and never confirms twice
items.rule: Two households requesting one free slot leave exactly one holder
items.evidence: 100 pairs of POST /api/bookings issued without awaiting either response; all 100 started free as checked in GET schedule, with give-up after each run. Counts: one-confirmed 100, both-confirmed 0, neither-confirmed 0; 100 give-ups succeeded.

items.name: The refusal for a closed day is judged usable
items.rule: A refusal is judged by whether a resident can act on it without asking again
items.evidence: The fresh agent named a request from the refusal; HTTP confirmation follows. Answer: REQUEST: pukuhuone 8 | Tuesday | 17:00

items.name: A free release offers only the selected occurrence
items.rule: Releasing one week preserves the standing holding
items.evidence: POST FREE release and POST take returned 201 and 200; selected date is held by apartment 3, following Tuesday by apartment 12; FREE billing remains with 12 and heater follows taker.

items.name: Releasing one week does not offer a different week
items.rule: Releasing one week preserves the standing holding
items.evidence: POST FREE release and take returned 201 and 200; selected Tuesday is taken by apartment 3; following Tuesday is held and heated for 12 with standing fee for 12.

items.name: An untaken release does not cancel the holding or its normal fee
items.rule: Releasing one week preserves the standing holding
items.evidence: POST FREE release for 2026-11-24; end 18:30 UTC; after date -u -s 18:31, app asOf 18:31 shows unclaimed, no heater, fee for 12; following week remains held by 12.

items.name: Taking a free occurrence charges no fee to the taker
items.rule: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences
items.evidence: POST FREE release and take returned 201 and 200; dated list and heater name 3, billing names only 12 for standing; following Tuesday list and heater name 12.

items.name: Taking a sale occurrence raises a distinct resale signal
items.rule: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences
items.evidence: POST SALE release and take returned 201 and 200; dated views name 3, resale billing names payer 3, occurrence release-3, kind resale, v1 and resale-fee; standing payer 12 and next Tuesday holder 12.

items.name: Withdrawing an untaken offer before its occurrence begins
items.rule: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences
items.evidence: POST withdraw returned 200 before occurrence; subsequent take returned 409 unavailable; dated list and heater restore 12, standing billing remains with 12 and next week remains held.

items.name: An accepted transfer cannot be withdrawn by the original holder
items.rule: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences
items.evidence: POST take by 3 returned 200, then withdrawal by 12 returned 409 unavailable; release and dated list and heater still show 3, standing bill and later week show 12.

items.name: An untaken offer expires when its occurrence begins
items.rule: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences
items.evidence: At actual boundary 2030-01-08 17:00 UTC, baseline date -u -s 2030-01-01 12:00:00 then advance to 2030-01-08 17:01:00; /api/state confirmed clock. Take returned 409 expired; release and posted list unclaimed, heater empty, standing bill and next Tuesday remain 12.

items.name: A taken occurrence has one taker in every view
items.rule: The three derived views describe one occurrence holder
items.evidence: FREE 2026-10-06: take outcome persisted taker 3; dated list, heater and billing and following Tuesday checked; normal fee remains with 12.

items.name: Two households try to take the same released occurrence
items.rule: The three derived views describe one occurrence holder
items.evidence: FREE 2026-10-06: take outcome persisted taker 3; dated list, heater and billing and following Tuesday checked; normal fee remains with 12.

items.name: A free eligible slot does not put a multi-slot household under notice
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: POST scarcity evaluate group A: 200 notices empty; GET notices empty.

items.name: An empty queue does not put a multi-slot household under notice
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: POST scarcity evaluate group A: 200 notices empty; GET notices empty.

items.name: A released occurrence is not a free standing slot
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: POST scarcity evaluate group A: Schedule still held for 12, one notice issued to 12. Released date views show unclaimed occurrence with no heater, standing fee remains with 12; later week 2026-12-01 shows 12 using and paying for standing holding.

items.name: Waiting in another resource group does not trigger notice here
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: POST scarcity evaluate group A: 200 notices empty; GET notices empty.

items.name: The queue is ordered by accepted request within its eligible group
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: GET queues A and B: A head is 3, entries ordered 3 then 4; B queue empty.

items.name: One multi-holding household receives only one active notice
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: POST scarcity evaluate twice: First response creates one notice for 12, second creates none; GET notices shows exactly one active with selected null.

items.name: The holder chooses before the choose deadline
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: POST /api/notices/notice-6/choose chose booking-1 and returned 200; GET /api/notices identified selected booking-1 and lapseAt, while GET /api/views showed both booking-1 and booking-3 still held and heated by 12.

items.name: The choice right passes after the shorter clock
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: Advanced the guest clock past the served chooseAt; GET /api/notices returned chooser 3 and no selected holding, while GET /api/views showed both standing bookings still held by 12. Exact deadlines and clock responses are in the transcript.

items.name: Passing the choose deadline does not pass the loss deadline
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: Advanced the guest clock past the served chooseAt; GET /api/notices retained the original later lapseAt, and GET /api/views showed both bookings still held by 12. Exact instants and clock responses are in the transcript.

items.name: Lapse changes only the selected standing holding
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: Chose booking-1, advanced the guest clock past served lapseAt, then GET /api/views showed only booking-3 in posted list and billing for 12; GET /api/bookings retained lapse history, and GET /api/schedule showed the selected slot free.

items.name: A confirmed queue claim takes effect only at lapse
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: POST /api/notices/notice-6/claim with household 3 and confirm returned 200; GET /api/notices reported pendingSuccessor 3 and selected booking-1. Before lapse, GET /api/views still showed booking-1 held and heated for 12.

items.name: A queue-head decline offers the holding to the next eligible entry
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: POST /api/notices/notice-7/claim with household 3 and decline returned 200; GET /api/notices offered the selected holding to 4 and GET /api/views still showed booking-1 held and heated for 12 before lapse.

items.name: If all claimants decline, the selected holding returns to the pool at lapse
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: After the only claimant 3 declined, advanced the guest clock past served lapseAt. GET /api/views showed only booking-3 held and billed to 12, and GET /api/schedule showed the selected 17:00 slot free.

items.name: A pending notice retains its original deadlines after the queue empties
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: POST /api/queue/queue-5/withdraw returned 200; GET /api/notices retained original chooseAt, lapseAt and policy v1. After advancing the guest clock past lapseAt, GET /api/schedule showed the selected slot free and GET /api/views retained only booking-3.

items.name: Different houses can open different resources and days
items.rule: A house owns its calendars and eligible booker roles
items.evidence: POST /api/houses created A with Tuesday and B with Saturday. GET /api/schedule for A returned Tuesday room 17:00; B returned only Saturday and no Tuesday.

items.name: Booker standing is checked within the household's house
items.rule: A house owns its calendars and eligible booker roles
items.evidence: Created A allowing shareholder and B allowing tenant; registered both roles in both houses. POST /api/bookings confirmed A shareholder and B tenant (201), and refused A tenant and B shareholder with booker-role (403). GET bookings confirmed the distinct persisted holders.

items.name: A manager-mediated house does not expose a resident self-service queue
items.rule: A house owns its calendars and eligible booker roles
items.evidence: GET /api/houses showed A route manager, B self-service; POST /api/queue for A returned 403 "Contact manager; this house does not offer a resident queue." The same request for B returned 200 and a waiting entry. Both houses were configured and households registered on fresh state.

items.name: A rule change records its authority and effective date
items.rule: Policy revisions and disputes preserve their evidence
items.evidence: Board recorded v2 effective 2026-10-02T00:00:00.000Z; v1 booking before and v2 booking after guest-clock advance observed.

items.name: A dispute can reconstruct one booking's decision
items.rule: Policy revisions and disputes preserve their evidence
items.evidence: Confirmed booking then gave it up; manager dispute response includes booking history and v1 policy evidence.

items.name: A policy revision does not rewrite an earlier refusal
items.rule: Policy revisions and disputes preserve their evidence
items.evidence: Closed-day refusal recorded with v1 and reason; board revision v2 recorded; GET state retains unchanged refusal.

items.name: A notice keeps the policy version that created its deadlines
items.rule: Policy revisions and disputes preserve their evidence
items.evidence: v1 notice retained chooseAt and lapseAt after board revision; guest clock crossed served effective instant and a later group B notice used v2 with 7/20-day deadlines.
